headline: Panache Digilife confirms full demat compliance in SEBI certificate filing
hook: Routine regulatory filing for small-cap firm
summary: Panache Digilife has submitted its compliance certificate to the stock exchanges confirming full dematerialization of its securities as required by SEBI regulations. The filing serves as a routine procedural update for shareholders regarding the company's depository operations. Retail investors holding shares in the company experience no change in operational status.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance update with no financial impact
